units.right_text: And the LORD said to Moses: “Tell your brother Aaron not to enter freely into the Most Holy Place behind the veil in front of the mercy seat on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.

units.left_text: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
units.right_text: This is how Aaron is to enter the Holy Place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

units.left_text: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.
units.right_text: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.

units.left_text: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
units.right_text: And he shall take from the congregation of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

units.left_text: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
units.right_text: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household.

units.left_text: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.right_text: Then he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

units.left_text: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
units.right_text: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats, one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat,

units.left_text: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.
units.right_text: he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.

units.left_text: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.
units.right_text: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to make atonement by sending it into the wilderness as the scapegoat.

units.left_text: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
units.right_text: When Aaron presents the bull for his sin offering and makes atonement for himself and his household, he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

units.left_text: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
units.right_text: Then he must take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and take them inside the veil.

units.left_text: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.
units.right_text: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the cloud of incense will cover the mercy seat above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

units.left_text: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
units.right_text: And he is to take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the mercy seat.

units.left_text: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
units.right_text: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood behind the veil, and with its blood he must do as he did with the bull’s blood: He is to sprinkle it against the mercy seat and in front of it.

units.left_text: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.
units.right_text: So he shall make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the impurities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting which abides among them in the midst of their impurities.

units.left_text: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
units.right_text: No one may be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he leaves, after he has made atonement for himself, his household, and the whole assembly of Israel.

units.left_text: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.
units.right_text: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He is to take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

units.left_text: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
units.right_text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

units.left_text: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
units.right_text: When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he is to bring forward the live goat.

units.left_text: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.
units.right_text: Then he is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to put them on the goat’s head and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task.

units.left_text: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
units.right_text: The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place, and the man will release it into the wilderness.

units.left_text: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.
units.right_text: Then Aaron is to enter the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen garments he put on before entering the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.

units.left_text: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
units.right_text: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.

units.left_text: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
units.right_text: He is also to burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

units.left_text: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
units.right_text: The man who released the goat as the scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may reenter the camp.

units.left_text: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.
units.right_text: The bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; and their hides, flesh, and dung must be burned up.

units.left_text: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
units.right_text: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and afterward he may reenter the camp.

units.left_text: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;
units.right_text: This is to be a permanent statute for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you shall humble yourselves and not do any work — whether the native or the foreigner who resides among you —

units.left_text: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
units.right_text: because on this day atonement will be made for you to cleanse you, and you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

units.left_text: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
units.right_text: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, that you may humble yourselves; it is a permanent statute.

units.left_text: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
units.right_text: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement. He will put on the sacred linen garments

units.left_text: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
units.right_text: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the assembly.

units.left_text: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.”
units.right_text: This is to be a permanent statute for you, to make atonement once a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:
units.right_text: “Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the Israelites and tell them this is what the LORD has commanded:

units.left_text: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
units.right_text: ‘Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp or outside of it

units.left_text: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.
units.right_text: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle— that man shall incur bloodguilt. He has shed blood and must be cut off from among his people.

units.left_text: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
units.right_text: For this reason the Israelites will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they have been offering in the open fields. They are to bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and offer them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.

units.left_text: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.right_text: The priest will then splatter the blood on the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

units.left_text: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’
units.right_text: They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves. This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come.’

units.left_text: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
units.right_text: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice

units.left_text: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.
units.right_text: but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man must be cut off from his people.

units.left_text: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
units.right_text: If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.

units.left_text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
units.right_text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for your souls upon the altar; for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.

units.left_text: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
units.right_text: Therefore I say to the Israelites, ‘None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner living among you eat blood.’

units.left_text: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
units.right_text: And if any Israelite or foreigner living among them hunts down a wild animal or bird that may be eaten, he must drain its blood and cover it with dirt.

units.left_text: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
units.right_text: For the life of all flesh is its blood. Therefore I have told the Israelites, ‘You must not eat the blood of any living thing, because the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it must be cut off.’

units.left_text: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
units.right_text: And any person, whether native or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening; then he will be clean.

units.left_text: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
units.right_text: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, then he shall bear his iniquity.”

units.left_text: The LORD said to Moses,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
units.right_text: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.

units.left_text: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: Keep My statutes and My judgments, for the man who does these things will live by them. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
units.right_text: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.right_text: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for that would shame your family.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
units.right_text: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her; she is your aunt.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you are not to have sexual relations with her.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would shame your brother.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
units.right_text: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
units.right_text: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her during her menstrual period.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
units.right_text: You must not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
units.right_text: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
units.right_text: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.

units.left_text: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
units.right_text: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves.

units.left_text: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
units.right_text: Even the land has become defiled, so I am punishing it for its sin, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.

units.left_text: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you
units.right_text: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances, and you must not commit any of these abominations— neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you.

units.left_text: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
units.right_text: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations, and the land has become defiled.

units.left_text: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
units.right_text: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.

units.left_text: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
units.right_text: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.

units.left_text: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.right_text: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
units.right_text: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.

units.left_text: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
units.right_text: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.

units.left_text: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
units.right_text: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.

units.left_text: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
units.right_text: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.

units.left_text: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
units.right_text: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people.

units.left_text: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
units.right_text: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

units.left_text: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not steal.
units.right_text: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him.
units.right_text: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
units.right_text: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people.
units.right_text: You must not go about spreading slander among your people.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
units.right_text: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘You shall keep my statutes.
units.right_text: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.

units.left_text: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
units.right_text: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

units.left_text: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
units.right_text: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.

units.left_text: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
units.right_text: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.

units.left_text: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
units.right_text: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.

units.left_text: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.
units.right_text: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.

units.left_text: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
units.right_text: You must not eat anything with blood still in it.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
units.right_text: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
units.right_text: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.

units.left_text: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
units.right_text: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.

units.left_text: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
units.right_text: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.

units.left_text: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
units.right_text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

units.left_text: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”
units.right_text: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.
units.right_text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.

units.left_text: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
units.right_text: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.

units.left_text: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
units.right_text: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,

units.left_text: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.
units.right_text: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.

units.left_text: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.
units.right_text: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.

units.left_text: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.
units.right_text: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.

units.left_text: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
units.right_text: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

units.left_text: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.
units.right_text: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.

units.left_text: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
units.right_text: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife— with the wife of his neighbor— both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.

units.left_text: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.right_text: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

units.left_text: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.right_text: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.

units.left_text: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.right_text: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

units.left_text: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
units.right_text: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.

units.left_text: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
units.right_text: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.

units.left_text: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
units.right_text: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

units.left_text: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.
units.right_text: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.

units.left_text: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
units.right_text: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.

units.left_text: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.
units.right_text: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.

units.left_text: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.
units.right_text: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.

units.left_text: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
units.right_text: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.

units.left_text: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
units.right_text: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.

units.left_text: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
units.right_text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

units.left_text: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
units.right_text: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance — a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.

units.left_text: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.
units.right_text: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.

units.left_text: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
units.right_text: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.

units.left_text: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
units.right_text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”

units.left_text: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,

units.left_text: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
units.right_text: except for his immediate family — his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,

units.left_text: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
units.right_text: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.

units.left_text: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
units.right_text: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.

units.left_text: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
units.right_text: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.

units.left_text: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.
units.right_text: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the food offerings, the food of their God, they must be holy.

units.left_text: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
units.right_text: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.

units.left_text: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
units.right_text: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy — I who set you apart.

units.left_text: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
units.right_text: If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.

units.left_text: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.
units.right_text: The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.

units.left_text: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
units.right_text: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.

units.left_text: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
units.right_text: The woman he marries must be a virgin.

units.left_text: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
units.right_text: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,

units.left_text: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”
units.right_text: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
units.right_text: “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.

units.left_text: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
units.right_text: No man who has any defect may approach — no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;

units.left_text: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
units.right_text: no man who has a broken foot or hand,

units.left_text: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
units.right_text: or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.

units.left_text: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
units.right_text: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the food offerings to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.

units.left_text: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
units.right_text: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food,

units.left_text: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
units.right_text: but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

units.left_text: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
units.right_text: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: Tell them that for the generations to come, if any of their descendants in a state of uncleanness approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from My presence. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
units.right_text: If a descendant of Aaron has a skin disease or a discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is clean. Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen,

units.left_text: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
units.right_text: or whoever touches a crawling creature or a person that makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be —

units.left_text: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
units.right_text: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening. He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

units.left_text: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
units.right_text: When the sun has set, he will become clean, and then he may eat from the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

units.left_text: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, which would make him unclean. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
units.right_text: The priests must keep My charge, lest they bear the guilt and die because they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

units.left_text: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
units.right_text: No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it.

units.left_text: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
units.right_text: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.

units.left_text: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
units.right_text: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.

units.left_text: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
units.right_text: But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house, she may share her father’s food as in her youth. But no outsider may share it.

units.left_text: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
units.right_text: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error, he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest.

units.left_text: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,
units.right_text: The priests must not profane the sacred offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD

units.left_text: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
units.right_text: by allowing the people to eat the sacred offerings and thus to bear the punishment for guilt. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:
units.right_text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and tell them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

units.left_text: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
units.right_text: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle, sheep, or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf.

units.left_text: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
units.right_text: You must not present anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

units.left_text: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
units.right_text: When a man presents a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without blemish or defect to be acceptable.

units.left_text: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.
units.right_text: You are not to present to the LORD any animal that is blind, injured, or maimed, or anything with a running sore, a festering rash, or a scab; you must not put any of these on the altar as a food offering to the LORD.

units.left_text: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
units.right_text: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.

units.left_text: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
units.right_text: You are not to present to the LORD an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn, or cut; you are not to sacrifice them in your land.

units.left_text: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
units.right_text: Neither you nor a foreigner shall present food to your God from any such animal. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and flawed.’”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.right_text: “When an ox, a sheep, or a goat is born, it must remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the LORD.

units.left_text: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
units.right_text: But you must not slaughter an ox or a sheep on the same day as its young.

units.left_text: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
units.right_text: When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD, offer it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf.

units.left_text: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: It must be eaten that same day. Do not leave any of it until morning. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
units.right_text: You are to keep My commandments and practice them. I am the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
units.right_text: You must not profane My holy name. I must be acknowledged as holy among the Israelites. I am the LORD who sanctifies you,

units.left_text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
units.right_text: who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
units.right_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘These are My appointed feasts, the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

units.left_text: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
units.right_text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
units.right_text: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times.

units.left_text: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
units.right_text: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

units.left_text: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
units.right_text: On the fifteenth day of the same month begins the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD. For seven days you must eat unleavened bread.

units.left_text: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
units.right_text: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly; you are not to do any regular work.

units.left_text: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
units.right_text: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD. On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.’”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: And the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
units.right_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.

units.left_text: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
units.right_text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

units.left_text: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.
units.right_text: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a year-old lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD,

units.left_text: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
units.right_text: along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil — a food offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma — and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.

units.left_text: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.right_text: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day you have brought this offering to your God. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.

units.left_text: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
units.right_text: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.

units.left_text: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
units.right_text: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
units.right_text: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.
units.right_text: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings — a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
units.right_text: You shall also prepare one male goat as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old as a peace offering.

units.left_text: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
units.right_text: The priest is to wave the lambs as a wave offering before the LORD, together with the bread of the firstfruits. The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

units.left_text: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
units.right_text: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come.

units.left_text: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.right_text: When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident. I am the LORD your God.’”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: The LORD also said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
units.right_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly announced by trumpet blasts.

units.left_text: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
units.right_text: You must not do any regular work, but you are to present a food offering to the LORD.’”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Again the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.right_text: “The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble yourselves, and present a food offering to the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
units.right_text: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.

units.left_text: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
units.right_text: If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people.

units.left_text: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
units.right_text: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.

units.left_text: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.right_text: You are not to do any work at all. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.

units.left_text: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
units.right_text: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath.”

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: And the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
units.right_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD begins, and it continues for seven days.

units.left_text: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
units.right_text: On the first day there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any regular work.

units.left_text: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
units.right_text: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD. On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.

units.left_text: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
units.right_text: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for presenting food offerings to the LORD — burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its designated day.

units.left_text: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
units.right_text: These offerings are in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s Sabbaths, and in addition to your gifts, to all your vow offerings, and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.

units.left_text: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
units.right_text: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the produce of the land, you are to celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days. There shall be complete rest on the first day and also on the eighth day.

units.left_text: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
units.right_text: On the first day you are to gather the fruit of majestic trees, the branches of palm trees, and the boughs of leafy trees and of willows of the brook. And you are to rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.

units.left_text: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
units.right_text: You are to celebrate this as a feast to the LORD for seven days each year. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come; you are to celebrate it in the seventh month.

units.left_text: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
units.right_text: You are to dwell in booths for seven days. All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths,

units.left_text: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.right_text: so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

units.left_text: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
units.right_text: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the LORD.

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
units.right_text: “Command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.

units.left_text: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
units.right_text: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come.

units.left_text: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
units.right_text: He shall tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually.

units.left_text: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
units.right_text: You are also to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf,

units.left_text: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
units.right_text: and set them in two rows — six per row — on the table of pure gold before the LORD.

units.left_text: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.right_text: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread, a food offering to the LORD.

units.left_text: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
units.right_text: Every Sabbath day the bread is to be set out before the LORD on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant.

units.left_text: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
units.right_text: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place; for it is to him a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD — his portion forever.”

units.left_text: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
units.right_text: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

units.left_text: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
units.right_text: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse. So they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)

units.left_text: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
units.right_text: They placed him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them.

units.left_text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.right_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

units.left_text: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
units.right_text: “Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have the whole assembly stone him.

units.left_text: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
units.right_text: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘If anyone curses his God, he shall bear the consequences of his sin.

units.left_text: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
units.right_text: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death; the whole assembly must surely stone him, whether he is a foreign resident or native; if he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.

units.left_text: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
units.right_text: And if a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.

units.left_text: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
units.right_text: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution — life for life.

units.left_text: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
units.right_text: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:

units.left_text: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
units.right_text: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. Just as he injured the other person, the same must be inflicted on him.

units.left_text: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
units.right_text: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.

units.left_text: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
